method: numpy.bincount over complete raw uint8 tensor bytes in 8 MiB chunks; Shannon zeroth-order entropy per tensor and pooled by type; includes quantization metadata within each tensor; no model execution

software.zstd: *** Zstandard CLI (64-bit) v1.5.7, by Yann Collet ***

zstd_level3_single_thread.note: Each per-type archive is a concatenation of tensors in GGUF order and is not itself a loadable GGUF. Whole-file archive requires decompression before standard GGUF loading. Timings taken under shared VM load and are not inference benchmarks.

interpretation_limits: H8 estimates marginal byte entropy, not a bound on blockwise/higher-order coding. No inference, quality, process RAM, or CPU-seconds per request were measured.

field_entropy.method: Full census of byte frequency by fixed GGUF block-field offset; pooled across tensors of each type. H8 is zero-order marginal byte entropy per field. 16,384 blocks maximum per chunk. Field byte accounting exactly partitions all Q4_K and Q6_K tensor bytes. Does not model within-field/block context or coding overhead.
